拍戏的时候，林姗姗倒是想下手，不过都被时笙避开了，她几次甩了空，导演又开始咆哮了，这次不但时笙被骂了，连林姗姗都被骂了。

时笙反正是不怕骂，她就当导演在放屁。

“你们到底还想不想拍了，就这状态，拍到明天也过不了！！”

林姗姗胸中燃烧着熊熊的烈火，这个江晚，她非要她知道厉害！

好不容易过了，林姗姗见时笙去了厕所，她也跟着进去，从后面大力推了时笙一下。

“江晚，刚才你是不是故意的！”

时笙扶着洗手台才没摔倒，她目光一沉，转身就是一巴掌甩了过去。

“这一巴掌是还你的。”

林姗姗被那一巴掌扇懵了，几秒钟后反应过来，张牙舞爪的去抓时笙的头发。

时笙早就防着她，灵巧的避开了她的手，绕到她后面，伸手将她往前推了一把，迅速退出厕所。

厕所的出来的方向，很多地方都能看到，林姗姗不敢以那个形象出现，时笙大摇大摆的离开。

等林姗姗收敛好情绪出来，片场已经没有时笙的身影了，林姗姗肺都快气炸了。

但是等她冷静下来，她就发现不对劲。

江晚胆小懦弱，她之前欺负她，她哪次敢吭声了，这次怎么忽然发飙了？

把那一巴掌打回来了，时笙没有给任何人打招呼，直接趁人不注意的时候溜走了，至于导演有什么愤怒，找席墨给她安排的那个经纪人去好了。

本宝宝不伺候！

既然席墨利用她，她可不会学原主，不知道利用。

时笙从身上搜出一张卡，她去银行查了下，里面只有三万，在这个圈子，这点钱，根本就不够看。

赚钱对她来说不难，但是三万块的启动资金，嗯……有点少。

短时间内想要快速的圈钱肯定是不行的。

就在时笙思考人生的时候，身上的电话忽然响了，时笙摸出手机看了一眼，她那个经纪人，拒接！

经纪人打了几次，被拒绝后，换成了助理。

拒接拒接！！

等手机铃声再次响起，时笙下意识的拒接，拒接完才看清来电显示上的名字，时笙瞥了瞥嘴，极其凶残的发了条短信过去——本宝宝在思考人生，别他妈打扰老子，让你的人也别打扰老子！！！

During the filming, Lin Shanshan wanted to attack, but Shi Sheng avoided her. She missed several times, and the director started yelling again. This time, not only Shi Sheng was scolded, but Lin Shanshan was also scolded.

Shi Sheng was not afraid of scolding anyway, so she just acted like the director was farting.

"Do you still want to shoot? In this state, we won't be able to make it through tomorrow!!"

Lin Shanshan's chest was burning with raging fire. She wanted Jiang Wan to know how powerful she was!

After finally getting over it, Lin Shanshan saw Shi Sheng going to the toilet. She followed him in and pushed Shi Sheng hard from behind.

"Jiang Wan, did you do it on purpose just now?"

Shi Sheng held on to the sink to keep from falling. Her eyes darkened, she turned around and slapped him away.

"This slap is for you."

Lin Shanshan was stunned by the slap. After a few seconds, she realized what she was doing and grabbed Shi Sheng's hair with all her teeth and claws.

Shi Sheng had been on guard against her for a long time, and nimbly avoided her hand, walked around behind her, stretched out his hand to push her forward, and quickly exited the toilet.

The direction from the toilet could be seen from many places. Lin Shanshan did not dare to appear in that image, and Shi Sheng left in a swaggering manner.

When Lin Shanshan calmed down and came out, Shi Sheng was no longer on the set, and Lin Shanshan's lungs almost exploded with anger.

But when she calmed down, she realized something was wrong.

Jiang Wan was timid and cowardly. She had bullied her before. When had she dared to say anything? Why did she suddenly get angry this time?

After getting that slap back, Shi Sheng didn't say hello to anyone and just slipped away when no one was paying attention. As for the director's anger, she should go to the agent Xi Mo arranged for her.

This baby doesn’t want to be taken care of!

Now that Xi Mo is taking advantage of her, she doesn't know how to imitate the original owner and take advantage of him.

Shi Sheng found a card from her body and went to the bank to check it. There was only 30,000 yuan in it. In this circle, this amount of money was simply not enough.

It is not difficult for her to make money, but the start-up capital of 30,000 yuan is, well... a bit small.

It is definitely not possible to make money quickly in a short period of time.

Just when Shi Sheng was thinking about life, the phone on her body suddenly rang. Shi Sheng took out the phone and took a look. Her agent refused to answer!

I called the agent several times and after being rejected, I was replaced by an assistant.

Refuse to accept!!

When the phone rang again, Shi Sheng subconsciously refused to answer it. After rejecting the call, she saw the name on the caller ID. Shi Sheng glanced at her mouth and sent a very cruel text message - I am thinking about life, don't fucking disturb me, and ask your people not to disturb me either!!!
